description: List the command (step) types available for a bot type, with a description and the bot types each applies to. Use this before authoring commands.

botType.description: The bot type, or omit to list all types. HTTP is a Protocol Bot script, BROWSER is a Browser Bot script, and PLAYWRIGHT is a Playwright script. "Browser script" is ambiguous: Browser Bot and Playwright are different types, so if the user's wording doesn't say which, ask before creating.

name: list_command_types
title: List Command Types
